events.name: Robert Platt
events.finding: Current Helping Hands join page explicitly welcomes master’s, undergraduate and visiting students. It recommends first contacting a PhD student whose research interests match, to discuss their current work. The separate funded PhD/postdoc section gives Platt’s email and does not promise funded master’s visits. The current lab roster lists Platt as director, a Fall2026 PhD arrival and a visiting student, supporting current lab-page context. Eight-week summer 2027 capacity, outside-master appointment, funding and access remain unconfirmed. Northeastern visiting-student requirements, including majority nonpersonal/nonfamily support, still apply.
